body.x: LAS VEGAS, USA (AVING Special Report on 'CES 2008') -- <Visual News> IPEVO, a leading manufacturer of Skype devices, unveiled its plan to extend its support to a broader range of VoIP applications and devices that enhance the overall Experience over IP.

The company is launching several products at CES 2008, including the ‘VoIP Conference Station’, an update to IPEVO’s award-winning conferencing device designed to integrate seamlessly with business quality Internet communications.

After spinning off from PChome Online in July 2007, IPEVO has continued to expand its iconic line of best-selling Skype hardware. IPEVO products have received numerous international design awards and recognitions, including 2006 & 2007 iF Product Design Awards, 2006 Reddot Design Award, 2006 Good Design Award (G-mark).

The company was also named to the prestigious “Red Herring 100 Asia” list. IPEVO plans to continue developing award-winning Skype products, while extending its reach into SIP-based VoIP and other Internet Experience products.

“Voice is an essential element of the Internet experience, but it’s not the only way people connect and communicate,” said Ed Lucero, VP & general manager of IPEVO North America. “Starting by expanding our support for various VoIP platforms, we’re going to broaden the way people experience the Internet with solutions that help us naturally interact over the web and fit seamlessly into our everyday lives.”
< AVING Special Report Team for ‘CES 2008’: Publisher and Editor, Min Choi, Kevin Choi, Caleb Ma, Jason Lee, Rose Kim, Alliyah Seo, Joshua Shim, Li Coffee, Brain Park >
